name: Morbidex Twiceborn
canonNotes: A Norscan warlord scarred by fire at his birth, who blames Tzeentch for it and sought Nurgle's help for revenge.
Nurglings reshaped him riddle by riddle into their own likeness; they travel with him still.
voiceNotes: Grinning, gruff and vindictive toward Tzeentch and its followers.
Speaks fondly of his Nurglings and in riddles when amused.
ttsInstructions: Gruff, grinning and wet, with a chuckle.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
